title: Take comparison to the washing place
summary: Sangat and Naam wash comparison out of the heart. Let contentment quiet the need to compare.
takeaway: Let contentment quiet the need to compare.
lifeApplication: When envy rises, step away from the screen and return the mind to one truthful task already in your hands today.

source.shortMeaning: Sangat and Naam wash comparison out of the heart.
source.lifeApplication: When envy rises, move toward the sangat, song, or prayer that leaves the heart cleaner than it found it.

evidence.coreClaim: Sangat and Naam wash comparison out of the heart.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: seek the company that washes the heart and turns it toward Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: When envy rises, step away from the screen and return the mind to one truthful task already in your hands today.
